title: Nucleoid-binding protein RicO anchors replication origins to the membrane to ensure correct chromosome segregation in Staphylococcus aureus
authors: Simon Schäper; Adrián Izquierdo-Martinez; Qin Liao; António D. Brito; Moritz Sorg; Bruno M. Saraiva; Najwa Taib; Xindan Wang; Mariana G. Pinho
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金黄色葡萄球菌中核仁结合蛋白RicO通过DNA结合域与膜锚定域桥接复制起点和细胞膜，确保染色体分离，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅湿实验验证，对本课题方法借鉴有限。
abstract: The mechanisms underlying chromosome segregation in bacteria, particularly in non-canonical models, remain incompletely understood. The coccoid bacterium Staphylococcus aureus encodes a limited set of conserved proteins involved in chromosome segregation, including the Structural Maintenance of Chromosomes (SMC) complex and an incomplete partition system. Here, we identified a protein of previously unknown function that interacts with the nucleoid and ensures accurate chromosome segregation in S. aureus . RicO (Regulator and Insulator of Chromosomal Origins) contains a conserved N-terminal DNA-binding domain that recognizes a specific sequence motif in the origin-proximal region of the chromosome, as well as a C-terminal amphipathic helix that interacts with the cell membrane, thereby bridging DNA and the membrane. RicO localizes in membrane-proximal foci at the tip of each hemisphere (or cell poles). Cells lacking RicO fail to correctly position replication origins at the cell poles and have weakened genomic interactions in the origin-proximal region, resulting in chromosome segregation defects. The combined absence of RicO and a functional SMC complex leads to nearly half of the population appearing as anucleate cells, indicating that these two systems are key contributors to chromosome segregation in S. aureus. Collectively, our data support a model in which RicO anchors chromosomal origins at the cell periphery to ensure genome maintenance in this spherical bacterial pathogen.
abstract_zh: 细菌染色体分离的机制，特别是在非经典模型中的机制，仍未完全阐明。球形细菌金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）编码一套有限的保守蛋白参与染色体分离，包括结构维护染色体（SMC）复合物和不完整的分配系统。在此，我们鉴定了一种功能未知的蛋白质，它与类核相互作用并确保金黄色葡萄球菌中准确的染色体分离。RicO（染色体起源的调节因子和绝缘子）包含一个保守的N端DNA结合域，识别染色体起源近端区域的特异性序列基序，以及一个与细胞膜相互作用的C端两亲性螺旋，从而桥接DNA和膜。RicO定位于每个半球尖端（或细胞极）的膜近端焦点。缺乏RicO的细胞无法在细胞极正确定位复制起点，并且起源近端区域的基因组相互作用减弱，导致染色体分离缺陷。RicO和功能性SMC复合物的联合缺失导致近一半的群体表现为无核细胞，表明这两个系统是金黄色葡萄球菌染色体分离的关键贡献者。总体而言，我们的数据支持一个模型，其中RicO将染色体起源锚定在细胞外周，以确保这种球形细菌病原体的基因组维持。
